teaser.en: Its species name means 'fever-chaser': across Africa its bark is a traditional remedy for fever.
teaser.sw: Jina la spishi yake maana yake ni 'mfukuza homa': kote Afrika gome lake ni dawa ya asili ya homa.

summary.en: This mng'andu is Crossopteryx febrifuga, a small savanna tree of the coffee family whose bark is used across Africa against fever. Digo speakers give it the same name as Brackenridgea zanguebarica.
summary.sw: Mng'andu huu ni Crossopteryx febrifuga, mti mdogo wa nyika wa familia ya mibuni ambao gome lake hutumika kote Afrika dhidi ya homa. Wadigo huupa jina lilelile la Brackenridgea zanguebarica.

about.en:
This *mng'andu* is a small, often crooked tree of the coffee family. Its leaves are opposite and oval, often softly hairy underneath. Small, sweet-scented white or cream flowers grow in dense rounded clusters at the ends of the branches. They are followed by clusters of small round capsules that split to release tiny winged seeds.

Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves and stem. App. V lists it as a shrub.
about.sw:
*Mng'andu* huu ni mti mdogo, mara nyingi uliopindapinda, wa familia ya mibuni. Majani yake huota kwa jozi zinazotazamana na ni ya duaradufu, mara nyingi yenye manyoya laini upande wa chini. Maua madogo meupe au ya rangi ya krimu yenye harufu tamu huota katika vishada vizito vya mviringo kwenye ncha za matawi. Baada yake huja vishada vya vifuko vidogo vya mviringo vinavyopasuka na kuachia mbegu ndogo sana zenye mabawa.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani na shina lake. Kiambatisho V kinauorodhesha kama kichaka.

where.en: It is a tree of savanna and dry woodland across tropical Africa, from West Africa to Kenya and south to Mozambique.
where.sw: Ni mti wa nyika na mapori makavu ya miti kote katika Afrika ya kitropiki, kuanzia Afrika Magharibi hadi Kenya na kusini hadi Msumbiji.

uses.en: Across its range the bark is used in traditional medicine, especially against fever, which is what *febrifuga*, 'fever-chaser', refers to. Pakia records no specific Digo use.
uses.sw: Kote unakopatikana, gome lake hutumika katika dawa za asili, hasa kutibu homa, ndiyo maana ya *febrifuga*, 'mfukuza homa'. Pakia haandiki matumizi mahususi ya Wadigo.

names.en: Pakia records *mng'andu* for this tree and also for *Brackenridgea zanguebarica*. He gives no meaning, and no other language is recorded as sharing the name. 'Crystal-bark' is an English name used in southern Africa, but it is not given by Pakia.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika *mng'andu* kwa mti huu na pia kwa *Brackenridgea zanguebarica*. Hatoi maana yake, na hakuna lugha nyingine iliyorekodiwa kutumia jina hili. Kwa Kiingereza kusini mwa Afrika huitwa *crystal-bark*, lakini Pakia hatoi jina hilo.

reason.en: Catunaregam, a bush tree of the same family
reason.sw: Catunaregam, mti wa vichakani wa familia ileile

reason.en: Fever pod, another bush medicine tree
reason.sw: Fever pod, mti mwingine wa dawa wa vichakani
